name: Belgium
contextBlurb: Belgium regulates stablecoins under MiCA and Belgian financial supervision. Fiat-backed stablecoins can be offered when the issuer qualifies and complies with MiCA's e-money token or asset-referenced token rules. Belgian authorities also retain AML, consumer-protection and financial-promotion oversight for crypto-asset services.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: MiCA provides Belgium's stablecoin regime for EMTs and ARTs, including authorisation, reserves, redemption, white papers and supervision.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Belgium follows MiCA. Stablecoins are legal with restrictions when issued as compliant EMTs or ARTs, with licensing, reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML obligations.

regulators.name: Financial Services and Markets Authority
regulators.role: Belgian conduct supervisor and MiCA national competent authority for relevant crypto-asset services.

regulators.name: National Bank of Belgium
regulators.role: Prudential supervisor for banks and payment/e-money institutions involved in stablecoin activity.
